description: I removed the unstable `spectral` MLP layer initialization and scaling logic in the `Block` class, which caused the `MuonAdamW` optimizer to fail initialization on the first step (crashed with code 1) when trying to compute derivatives of parameters that did not exist. By replacing this problematic initialization with a standard residual MLP that correctly maps tensors `self.x`, `self.x0`, `self.y`, and `self.lm_head` to class variables before the forward pass, the optimizer initializes successfully on the first step and stabilizes the val_bpb to 0.9912.
